deviations.what: onInit loops over the eight core:InvisibleTexts and calls headerContainer.addAriaLabelledBy(text<i>). The association is static (the ids never change), so the port writes it as the HeaderContainer.ariaLabelledBy attribute listing all eight ids instead of building it imperatively.

press shows MessageToast.show('Fire press') - a constant text, so all eight NumericContent presses are composed on the client via follow_up_action control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show and need no round-trip.
